shots.caption: Welcome to Vesper. This city needs water, food, and fuel from the land around it. Supplies are running low.
shots.label: THE PALE BASIN · MOURNING FEN

shots.caption: The city’s leaders have left. Their computer system, Continuance, still sends machines to collect old debts. People lose water and heat when they cannot pay.
shots.label: VESPER · STREETS AND SKYWAYS

shots.caption: Four factions are trying to help. Your faction gives you quests. Oru gives you quests about your character’s background.
shots.label: AFTERLIGHT COMMONS · MEET YOUR CONTACT

shots.caption: Learn the controls in the First Steps Courtyard, then meet your faction contact. Nella’s kitchen has no water and fourteen diners are missing. Help reopen it and find out what happened.
shots.label: FIRST STEPS COURTYARD · LEARN THE CONTROLS
